steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: On 27 February 1933, the Reichstag building in Berlin was set on fire. Marinus van der Lubbe, a Dutch Communist, was found at the scene and arrested. Hitler used the fire to persuade Hindenburg to issue the Decree for the Protection of the People and State on 28 February 1933, which suspended all civil liberties.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: In the March 1933 election, the Nazis won 43.9% of the vote (288 seats). This was not a majority, but combined with the DNVP's 8% (52 seats), Hitler had a majority in the Reichstag. The election was held in an atmosphere of terror - SA thugs patrolled the streets, opposition meetings were banned, and the Communist Party was effectively illegal.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Enabling Act (Law to Remedy the Distress of the People and the Reich), passed on 23 March 1933, gave Hitler the power to make laws without the Reichstag for four years. This effectively made Hitler a legal dictator. It required a two-thirds majority, which Hitler achieved by arresting Communists and intimidating the remaining deputies.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: On 14 July 1933, the Law Against the Formation of New Parties made the NSDAP the only legal political party in Germany. Attempting to form or maintain another party became a criminal offence. Germany was now a one-party state.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Explain how the Reichstag Fire helped Hitler consolidate power. (4 marks) | How important was the Enabling Act in the establishment of the Nazi dictatorship? (8 marks) | "The Night of the Long Knives was the most important event in Hitler's consolidation of power." How far do you agree? (12 marks)

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Know the exact sequence: Fire (27 Feb) → Decree (28 Feb) → Election (5 Mar) → Enabling Act (23 Mar) → Unions banned (2 May) → Parties banned (14 Jul) → Night of Long Knives (30 Jun) → Fuhrer (2 Aug) The Enabling Act was passed using LEGAL methods (vote in the Reichstag) but under ILLEGAL conditions (Communists excluded, SA intimidation) The Night of the Long Knives was RETROACTIVELY legalised - this shows the complete absence of rule of law Always distinguish between consolidation of power (1933-34) and the RISE to power (1929-33) - these are different topics The army oath (2 August 1934) was crucial - it meant the army was bound to Hitler personally, not to the state The Nazis never won a majority in a free election - Hitler consolidated power by destroying democracy from within
